what: ZTO Express is one of China's largest parcel delivery companies. It moves billions of packages a year for e-commerce platforms through a network of line-haul trucks, sorting hubs and franchised local pickup and delivery outlets.
customers: Chinese e-commerce sellers and platforms, and the consumers receiving parcels.
money: parcel sorting and line-haul transport, with local collection franchised
moat: Owning the sorting hubs and long-haul fleet while franchising the local legs, which gives it scale economics on the expensive part and low fixed cost on the rest.
risks: Chinese parcel price competition has been severe and regulators have intervened to stop it
Volume growth has come at falling revenue per parcel
Chinese regulatory and geopolitical risk affects US-listed Chinese shares
opportunities: Revenue grew about 16% last year with a 21% operating margin
Cash of about $4.7 billion exceeds its debt
Regulatory pressure against below-cost pricing would benefit the lowest-cost operator
watch: Parcel volume growth and revenue per parcel.
